verdict.rationale: Slack ships Slackbot, described as 'your personal AI agent' that summarizes channels, drafts briefs, and answers questions (e.g. 'update deals just by asking Slackbot'), plus AI huddle note-taking, matching the delegation story to some degree. However, evidence is largely vendor marketing copy with no independent confirmation of depth/reliability, and community evidence is silent on AI assistant quality (focused instead on pricing/export/UX complaints), leaving confidence limited.
